name: Echo of Nozdormu replaces Explode as soon as the talent is taken at level 10 (COA-5810)
contract: Echo of Nozdormu 520937 is the first Draconic talent and can be taken at level 10. Its passive transforms
Explode (chain of 800792) into Echo of Nozdormu. AscensionPyromancer::Refresh learned only the Echo ranks whose
SpellLevel is at or below the player's level, and rank 1 802174 has SpellLevel 11, so a level 10 Pyromancer
learned no Echo rank and Explode stayed Explode until level 11. Rank 1 is now always taught while the talent is
active; higher ranks still follow the player's level, and losing the talent still removes every rank.
